# MCP OAuth 2.1 Security
#### Key Takeaways
- OAuth 2.1 is now the MCP auth standard.

## Refresh Token Rotation and the Token Lifecycle
Long-lived refresh tokens are one of the most commonly exploited weaknesses.

### OAuth 2.1 Is the Foundation
Short life spans, refresh token rotation, strict audience validation.
